status._note: Sigil additions (not in CESAC): traffic light. Each pairs with an icon and a word, never colour alone. Contrast checked against the text colour listed.

power._note: CESAC's four powers mapped to Sigil's four jobs. Colours from components/f4/bits.tsx.

font.display: Big Shoulders (next/font, opsz axis; weights 800-900, uppercase)

rules: Never pill shapes: buttons, tags and chips are rounded rectangles (CESAC committee rule).
Status colours always come with an icon and a word. SVG line icons, no emoji icons (CESAC PRD).
Minimum tap target 56px; primary button full width on mobile. Body text >= 18px on mobile.
No em dashes in UI copy (CESAC PRD). No fake metrics, reviews or counters.
Original artwork only: no Marvel characters or logos, no circled-4 emblem, no character-name captions. The CESAC mark and logo appear only as team branding.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: every animation has a still fallback.
